comments.value: Please fix this update, Roleplay is literally the only reason I get on bro 😭
Several Pvp & rp groups are highly effected by this
All PVP or RP groups no matter what franchise wish for this issue to get fixed and fixed fast. By all means that has us crippled right now

Please Fix this update or at least make it into a toggle. Many RP and PvP servers will die from this update. While it is useful for people who do not want to see these animations in say a large public, all of the PvP and Roleplay communities do NOT want this.

Just making it a toggle would be better than this, just like the personal space setting.

I want this update to be completely removed because its been ruining alot of my rp and pvp groups, if it isnt removed or at least made toggleable then long ranged combat in alot of these groups will become impossible
Need to undo this terrible new update, it's killing avatar pvp
As someone who runs a massive RP community that does various types of roleplay combat missions, this is a major issue that effects how we do things horribly.
Remove it bro, stop with these updates
I believe that animator culling and impostors should be able to be disabled by users and force disabled by world makers. impostors being disabled would make it so fallbacks are rendered instead.

We believe this issue has been addressed in the most recent patch release of VRChat, 2025.1.1p1 (build 1568). If you are still encountering issues in this latest version, please open a new bug report including the ID of at least one avatar suffering from the issue and steps we can follow to reproduce the problem you're seeing.

This issue is believed to be caused by gestures being culled at a distance on remote avatars, rather than being related to recent changes to distance hiding that only come into effect when distance hiding is explicitly turned on.

details: so in the new update a new feature made it so that animators are disabled at distance. however it has been affecting me and other players even when the feature is disabled this messes with a few avatar pvp systems that require animators to be constantly enabled. the feature itself seems to work but it is activating even when hide beyond is disabled.
